top_signals.title: Singapore's Gan Kim Yong: Trust and Cooperation Are Key
top_signals.summary: Singapore's Deputy PM Gan Kim Yong cites Singapore’s strong economic ties with China, India and Canada as examples of collaboration that helps the respective countries meet their needs and create a better future. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Indonesia fuel shortages spread to Bali, other regions as prices climb
US Army, Navy research labs team up to combat Arctic cold
top_signals.summary: As the Department of Defense eyes greater operability in the Arctic, it needs equipment that can operate in temps as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.

top_signals.title: Chinese AI firms tap cheaper ‘dim sum’ offshore yuan debt for funding edge
top_signals.summary: The 10-year and 30-year portions of Tencent's recently priced offshore yuan securities carried coupons well below the yields on dollar notes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
